_comment: Copy this file to env.json and fill in your real values. env.json is gitignored. Run/build with: --dart-define-from-file=env.json
_comment_google: Google Sign-In (optional; native signInWithIdToken flow). GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID is the 'Web application' OAuth client ID and is REQUIRED to enable the Google button (also paste it into Supabase's Google provider). GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID is the iOS OAuth client ID (its REVERSED form also goes in ios/Runner/Info.plist). Android needs no client ID here. Leave GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID empty to hide the Google button.
_comment_dev_login: TEST ONLY. Set DEV_LOGIN to true in a DEV env.json to enable the code-email sign-in bypass (also needs the dev-login Edge Function with DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED=true). NEVER set true in a production build.
